model_reporting_note: Requested model IDs are recorded separately from returned fields. Empty reported_model_dataset_fields means the API did not independently report a model/dataset name.

marine.dataset_note: NOAA NCEP GFS Wave archived model forecast, documented 0.25 degree grid (about 25 km), hourly, available since June 2024. Selected after ERA5-Ocean returned null/undefined for all requested wind-wave and swell components. No ERA5-Ocean values enter the final table.

weather.dataset_note: ECMWF IFS historical analysis assembled by Open-Meteo, about 9 km, hourly. Explicitly selected because the documented ERA5 variable matrix does not provide wind gusts.

unused_cache_attribution: Diagnostic ERA5-Ocean responses: Open-Meteo.com and ECMWF/Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S). These values are not used in the final table.
